scope: CI regression diagnosis and fix for the reference-primal path after the deferred-set closure: commit 3662cac made an unconditional fresh LU refactorize run after every accepted pivot, which regressed LP-heavy tests 3x in Debug/TSan/ASan builds until they exceeded their CI budgets. The fix restores trigger-only refactorization while keeping the pivot-time solve gates.

passing_jobs: Optional ML compilation and fallback contract
provenance.host: single host for local measurements, gcc 22.1.8 / clang 22.1.8, 12 cores

symptoms.detail: all five failed jobs timed out on the same LP/MILP-heavy tests; Release jobs stayed green, so this was a per-pivot cost regression, not a solver-path pathology

gcc_debug_timings_seconds.median_note: the run was not uniformly slower (median test got faster); only LP-heavy tests regressed 1.9-3.2x

root_cause.defect: the tie-trial pivot commit called factor.refactorize() unconditionally after every accepted pivot (a from-scratch sparse LU per pivot), where 8a2a94b only refactored when factor.needs_refactorization() fired (update/density triggers). Introduced in 3662cac together with the deferred-set fixes, so it shipped in the same commit BENCH-04 pinned.
root_cause.evidence: local Debug on tests/fixtures/scale_200.mps: 8a2a94b = 1466.04 ms / 1567 iterations (0.94 ms per iteration), 692967b = 4927.6 ms / 933 iterations (5.28 ms per iteration) despite 41% fewer pivots; process_network_large local Debug 9.93 s -> 37.61 s (CI 17.18 s -> 60.01 s budget timeout)
ruled_out: singular floor 1e-10 (reverted: 40.62 s vs 37.61 s baseline, no change)
refactorize fill-reducing ordering true/false (reverted: 50.14 s, no change; ordering consistency fix itself kept)
bland_anti_cycling default flip (reverted: 8584 ms vs 4927 ms on scale_200, i.e. slower, and irrelevant to node_lp which sets the flag explicitly)

fix.change: factor.refactorize() restored behind the needs_refactorization() trigger at the accepted-pivot commit; the basis_solves_cleanly gates (transpose solve + primal solve residual checks against the drift gate, plus the snap-tolerance feasibility probe) remain per committed pivot, so a committed basis must still solve cleanly and the eta-chain singularities the fresh LU was meant to catch are still rejected by the residual gates.
